info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Andreline Lolo (BK)
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-22-2026 at 09:09 PM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Andreline Lolo, a 73-year-old Black Female, last seen near Montgomery Street and New York Avenue in Brooklyn at approximately 9:00 AM on 10-12-2026. Andreline has dementia, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: Black hair. Unknown clothing description.
If you see Andreline, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Andreline is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sHKNiA
